narrative.intro: Optumrx Administrative Services has $509M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Optumrx Administrative Services received 4 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $127M. Optumrx Administrative Services obligations are up 105.4% year over year. Historical obligations for Optumrx Administrative Services show a stepped pattern: $2.2K in FY21, $3.2M in FY22, $66.9K in FY23, $174M in FY24, $248M in FY25, and $509M in FY26. Optumrx Administrative Services current-year totals are partial because the period covers fiscal year to date, and the reported figures are contract obligations except where award-value wording indicates total contract values. Optumrx Administrative Services is operating at a substantially higher run rate in FY26 than in recent prior years based on the reported obligation totals and the provided year-over-year change.
